title: Asking Mary his purpose in the Middle East: "You're here to be here"

tellings.quote: And got back kind of a again, nothing verbal or just a an answer, which was, "You're here to be here."

plain: A man called Ralph, who says he served as a senior CIA officer, says that sometime between 2011 and 2016, while in the Middle East, he silently asked a presence he calls Mary why he was there. He says the answer came back without words: "You're here to be here." He tells it as a moment of guidance from beyond the ordinary, and mentions a Jesuit priest friend in connection with it.
